address_source: Google Maps business listing detail page
phone_source: Google Maps listing + visible on trailer signage in own photos
email_note: No public email found. No own website (checked realmovingandstorage.com: parked/for-sale Sedo domain, not the business). No Instagram/Facebook profile found (IG API calls returned blocked/empty twice). Omitted rather than invented.

language_note: All Google reviews found are in English; trailer signage and marketing graphics are in English.
services_mentioned: long-distance moves (Florida to Georgia mentioned in a review)

review_samples.author: Julia Mullins Birt
review_samples.text: This is one of the best moving crews we have ever used. Octavio and Domingo were so professional and at the same time pleasant. They took exceptional care with all of our belongings and ended up taking more for us than originally planned. I highly recommend these fellows and the company.

review_samples.author: Mary Majka
review_samples.text: Very passionate about his business. Gives great advice. Wastes no time. Very careful with his customers possessions. Highly recommend.

review_samples.author: AJ Gomez
review_samples.text: We have used Real Moving & Octavio numerous times for moves within Southwest Florida and between Florida and Georgia.

review_samples.author: marcelo palacios
review_samples.text: I hire Octavio for a local move from a storage to our new home in Lehigh. He was very punctual when we met at the storage area on a Sunday morning. It took about 8 hours to complete.

photos_source: Google Maps photo viewer (gmaps_photocycle.js), 11 photos pulled, 1 exact duplicate removed, 10 unique real photos used across hero/about/gallery.
discovery_method: node scripts/gmaps_discover.js "mudanzas movers in Fort Myers, FL" 4 -> candidate had hasWebsiteButton:false, verified with gmaps_detail.js and a manual domain check.
dedup_check: Not present in data/processed.json (checked by name/phone against city filter Cape Coral|Fort Myers|Naples) and no existing output/ folder before this build.
